name: tech-debt-mcp
description: Static technical-debt analyzer for 14 languages, exposed as an MCP server.
long_description: Tech Debt MCP scans source files across TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Go, Rust, C, C++, C#, Ruby, PHP, and Objective-C for code smells, SQALE metrics, dependency issues, and user-defined patterns. Exposes 16 MCP tools and 2 resource templates for use from Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and any MCP-compatible client.

tools.name: analyze_project
tools.description: Analyze an entire project for technical debt.

tools.name: analyze_file
tools.description: Analyze a single file for technical debt issues.

tools.name: get_debt_summary
tools.description: Get a quick summary of technical debt in a project.

tools.name: get_sqale_metrics
tools.description: Get SQALE technical debt metrics including remediation time, debt ratio, and rating.

tools.name: list_supported_languages
tools.description: List all programming languages supported by the analyzer.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Get prioritized recommendations for addressing technical debt.

tools.name: get_issues_by_severity
tools.description: Get all issues of a specific severity level.

tools.name: get_issues_by_category
tools.description: Get all issues of a specific category.

tools.name: add_custom_rule
tools.description: Add a custom pattern-based tech debt rule.

tools.name: remove_custom_rule
tools.description: Remove a custom rule by ID.

tools.name: list_session_custom_rules
tools.description: List custom rules registered in this server session via add_custom_rule. Does NOT include customPatterns declared in .techdebtrc.json (those run inside analyze_project via AnalysisEngine but are not surfaced here). Renamed from list_custom_rules (TEC-51) for clarity; the old name is no longer registered.

tools.name: execute_custom_rules
tools.description: Execute all custom rules against code or a file.

tools.name: validate_custom_pattern
tools.description: Validate a custom pattern before adding it as a rule.

tools.name: check_dependencies
tools.description: Analyze project dependencies across multiple package managers.

tools.name: validate_config
tools.description: Validate a .techdebtrc.json configuration file for syntax and schema correctness.

tools.name: get_vulnerability_report
tools.description: Generate an offline dependency report listing all project dependencies for vulnerability review.
